description: Sri Lanka Anti Doping Agency - Convention against Doping in Sports Act No 33, 2013
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013. It publishes the official 2024 Prohibited List as an International Standard under the World Anti-Doping Code. This constitutes regulatory/legal framework establishment rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
